ambiguities_or_notes: All 30 apparatus entries, their page/line coordinates, boundary phrases, and Sovremennik relations are represented.

The source says page 194 for the duel passage amid page-103/104 entries. A separate transcription of the academic volume reproduces the same '194', confirming this as a source/printed-apparatus anomaly rather than a local Markdown mutation. It is preserved verbatim rather than silently corrected to 104.

любишь, не любишь is a nineteenth-century name for the banking card game also known as shtoss/faro; the source phrase is retained as italic 'love-me, love-me-not' rather than interpreted as romantic language.
предпочтение diminutive преферансик is rendered 'a little preference', referring to the card game preference, preserving the marker's diminutive tone.
The coarse colloquial boundaries в морду заехать, исколочу, дерет с мужика последнюю шкуру are rendered directly rather than sanitized.
No omitted span is reconstructed from the base story: where the apparatus supplies only opening and closing boundary words, only those boundaries are translated.
